the use of NDCP alongwith ATMP as cathode in MFCs, enhances ORR, minimizes chemical fouling, improves long term stability of MFCs, and thus increases the maximum power density of the MFCs.
NDCP alongwith ATMP could be successfully used for fabrication of cathode in a MFC to achieve stable power output by minimizing scale formation and effective wastewater treatment.
nitrogen doped carbon catalyst along with anti-scaling agent (ATMP) was used to improve oxygen reduction reaction in a microbial fuel cell.

the fabrication of a novel cathode material for MFCs.
the development of a fouling resistant cathodic system in MFCs using NDCP with ATMP.
the development of a cost-effective fouling resistant cathodic material, nitrogen doped carbon (NDCP), for microbial fuel cell ( MFC ).
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the NDCP cathodes along with anti-scaling agent (ATMP) in MFCs have high electrochemical performance with stable long term operation.
nitrogen doped carbon (NDCP)/amino-tri-methylene phosphate (ATMP) composite is a promising cathode for MFCs.
the NDCP alongwith ATMP could be a promising and cost effective cathode for the MFCs for long term stable power generation and wastewater treatment.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have used nitrogen doped carbon (NDCP), which has high electroactive surface area, meso-porous and ultrathin shell structure for fabrication of fouling resistant cathodes.

we have successfully developed an effective and stable fouling resistant cathodic system for microbial fuel cell using nitrogen doped carbon powders as cathode alongwith anti scaling agent (ATMP) in its cathode.
we have used NDCP along-with ATMP in a MFC to achieve long term stable performance.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of NDCP as a cathode in MFCs can increase ORR and power density.
NDCP alongwith ATMP can be used as a cost effective cathode in MFC for stable and efficient wastewater treatment.
NDCP with ATMP as cathode material is highly efficient in MFCs for wastewater treatment.
